hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.go) cd "${f%%/src/*}/src" && go build ./... && go vet ./... ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */infrastructure/chatwoot/client.go) grep -q 'escapeChatwootPathSegment' "$f" || echo '{"systemMessage":"AVISO: escapeChatwootPathSegment (delta do fork) desapareceu de client.go — o upstream usa url.PathEscape cru e o update_last_seen do Chatwoot volta a dar 404 em HTML"}' ;; esac; }
